protocol_semantics.global_discovery: Pinctrl attributes expose the global 140-pin inventory; mutation permissions are agent-specific.
protocol_semantics.configure_permission: EXCLUSIVE or higher required for pin and daisy mutation.
protocol_semantics.request_permission: EXCLUSIVE or higher required for pin request.
protocol_semantics.read_only_discovery: Pin attributes and settings discovery remain globally addressable for valid pin IDs.

qualification_boundary: This contract is a lossless projection of the full generated symbolic evidence artifact.
The full symbolic map is regenerated from pinned NXP source on every qualification run.
Permission and functional configuration state do not prove physical pad electrical behavior, mux side effects, ownership arbitration timing, or signal propagation.
